title: Bacon & Egg (in a) Muffin
ldIngredientsRaw: 12 ½ oz all purpose flour (2 ½ cups, see note)
7 ½ oz yellow corn meal (1 ½ cups)
2 oz butter ( or bacon fat, melted)
ldInstructionsRaw: Bring 1 inch of water to a boil in a small pot. Gently place the 6 cold eggs into the pot, cover. Reduce the heat to medium and steam the eggs for exactly 5 minutes. Remove the pot from the stove and immediately fill the pot with cold water to stop the cooking. Let the eggs cool in the water for 5 minutes then place in the refrigerator to cool completely.

When you're ready to make the muffin batter, put the eggs into the freezer while making the batter (up to 1/2 hr). Cook the bacon slices until crisp, chop into small bacon bits. Grease a 6-cup jumbo muffin tin with butter or bacon fat, then flour.
